i.x: Congratulations to Elaine Luria and Shannon Taylor on their victories! Virginians are sending two outstanding leaders to Congress who will get to work on day one to bring down prices. Proud to have campaigned alongside them—and excited to get to work together for Virginians!
What a night! Congratulations to my friend, Senator Mark Warner, on his resounding re-election. Virginia is damn lucky to have him fighting for us.

I've been out at the polls all day, talking to incredible people who showed up to make their voices heard in this election. They're the reason I do this work, and every one of them reminded me what's at stake.

Ten years of Trump and Trumpism is enough. Enough of being told to hate our neighbors. Enough of an enemies list that grows by the day. Today, we can start to turn the page. Polls are open until 7 PM in Virginia. Find your polling place at iwillvote.com.
It’s Election Day! Text or call 5 of your friends and get them out to vote. iwillvote.com.

It’s Election Day, Virginia! 🗳️ Polls are open 6 AM to 7 PM. Find your polling location at iwillvote.com. ✅ Vote for Mark Warner and Democrats up and down the ballot ✅ Vote YES on all 3 constitutional amendments This is our chance to put a check on this administration. Make your voices heard.

What an Election Eve! I spent today with Virginians across our Commonwealth working to turn out every single vote. Thank you to every volunteer who knocked a door, made a call, or showed up today. You're going to make the difference.

Closed out the day in Alexandria with Mark Warner, Don Beyer, and a room full of Virginians ready to win! Virginia Beach to Henrico, Fluvanna, and Fairfax, the message was the same everywhere: Virginians are fed up with Washington. Tomorrow, we send a message and start moving our country forward.
